description: QR Code. Generate a styled QR code via GET. Output: SVG (default) or PNG. Supports dot styles, gradients, custom corners and all QR versions. Credit cost: 3 credits per call.

aria_label.description: Accessible label added as aria-label on the SVG element. Example: ?aria_label=QR+code+linking+to+chartquery.com

background.description: Background color. Default: #fff. Set to transparent for no background. Example: ?background=%230f172a for dark background. Use %23 to encode #.

color.description: Module color as CSS hex. Default: #000. Examples: ?color=%236366f1 (indigo), ?color=%23dc2626 (red), ?color=%23059669 (green), ?color=%230891b2 (teal). Use %23 to URL-encode #. For gradient objects, use POST instead.

data.description: Data to encode in the QR code. Examples:

desc.description: SVG <desc> element for extended accessibility description. Example: ?desc=Scan+to+visit+https://chartquery.com

dot_size.description: Module size ratio between 0.1 and 1. Default: 1 (full). Values below 1 add spacing between modules for a lighter look. Example: ?dot_size=0.85

dot_type.description: Module (dot) shape. Default: square. Controls the visual style of each QR code module. Allowed values: square, rounded, dots, diamond, classy, classy-rounded, extra-rounded, vertical-line, horizontal-line, small-square, tiny-square. Default: "square".

ec_level.description: Error correction level. Default: M. Higher levels allow more damage/obscuring before the code becomes unreadable. Allowed values: L, M, Q, H. Default: "M".

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

format.description: Output format. Default: svg. Use png to get a raster image. SVG is lossless and scalable; PNG is pixel-based and suitable for email, PDF or messaging. Example: ?format=png Allowed values: svg, png. Default: "svg".

margin.description: Quiet zone width in modules around the QR code. Default: 4. Minimum recommended by the QR standard: 4. Example: ?margin=2 (compact) or ?margin=6 (extra padding).

mask.description: Mask pattern from 0 to 7. Default: auto (best mask selected to minimize visual patterns). Only set manually if you need a deterministic output. Example: ?mask=3

mode.description: Encoding mode. Default: auto (best mode selected for the data). Use numeric for digits-only, alphanumeric for uppercase + digits, byte for arbitrary text/UTF-8. Example: ?mode=numeric Allowed values: auto, numeric, alphanumeric, byte. Default: "auto".

shape.description: Overall QR code shape. Default: square. Use circle to clip the entire QR into a circle: great for profile/avatar-style codes. Example: ?shape=circle&dot_type=dots Allowed values: square, circle. Default: "square".

share.description: Set share=true to persist the config and receive JSON instead of an image: { id, render_url, view_url, embed_url, expires_in }. Free plan: 3-day expiry with watermark. Paid plan: 6-month expiry, no branding. Default: false.

size.description: Output size in pixels (width = height). Default: 200. Examples: ?size=200 (thumbnail), ?size=300 (standard), ?size=400 (large), ?size=600 (poster). For print, use the unit param with mm/cm instead.

title.description: SVG <title> element shown as a browser tooltip and used by screen readers. Example: ?title=ChartQuery+Website

unit.description: Measurement unit for the size param. Default: px. Use mm, in or cm with the size param for print-ready output. Example: ?size=50&unit=mm Allowed values: px, mm, in, cm. Default: "px".

version.description: QR version from 1 to 40 (determines grid size and data capacity). Leave unset for auto-selection based on data length and ec_level. Example: ?version=5

xml_declaration.description: Prepend an XML declaration (<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>) to the SVG output. Useful when the SVG will be used as a standalone XML file. Default: false. Example: ?xml_declaration=true

name: qrcode
title: QR Code
